title: Convert callback-based data-access API to async/await
description: A core data-access module exposes a Node-style callback API (fn(args, (err, result) => {...})). Convert its internal implementation and public surface to Promise-returning async functions, providing a thin backward-compatible callback wrapper for any external callers that cannot be updated in this change.
acceptanceCriteria: The module's primary functions return Promises and can be used with async/await.
A callback-style wrapper is provided so existing callback-based call sites in the fixture continue to work without modification.
Errors that previously arrived as the callback's err argument now reject the returned Promise with an equivalent error.
All existing tests pass either unchanged (via the wrapper) or updated to the new Promise-based style, not both duplicated.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run the module's tests in both the async/await call style and, for the wrapper, the original callback style.
groundTruth: Internal implementation is rewritten using async/await; a callbackify-style wrapper (native util.callbackify or an equivalent local implementation) adapts the new Promise-based functions back to the old callback signature for any callers not migrated in this change.
